card.name: Words just before pathogen or organism
card.fires_on: Words in infection text that come right before 'organism', 'pathogens' or 'bacterial species', such as 'causative', 'opportunistic', 'susceptible' and 'the' after 'susceptibility of'.

modes.label: Causative or opportunistic
